dogecoin.text:
@APompliano Crypto exchange Gemini has become the latest company to trade Dogecoin.

Trading opens on Gemini's API/FIX and Active Trader applications against the U.S. $ followed by its mobile and web app, for currencies,  US dollar, British pound, euro, Canadian, Australian, Hong Kong dollar

@DelJayare @BotOfDogecoin @coinbase Today, Gemini, a regulated crypto exchange, wallet and custodian, will provide trading and custody support for Dogecoin, the exchange's co-founder and CEO Tyler Winklevoss said in a post.
